results.description: Dingding specializing in the production of precision ceramics (zirconia, alumina, silicon carbide, etc.), tungsten alloys, high specific gravity tungsten-based alloys, stainless steel and other powder metallurgy products; Outstanding achievements have been made in the fields of smart wear, textile and cutting-edge materials. The company is committed to the design, development and production of metal and ceramic powder injection molding and manufacturing processes, which are suitable for all kinds of complex shapes and high-performance decorative parts and functional parts. ◆With increasing innovation ability, outstanding flexible customization ability and increasingly perfect delivery ability, we are constantly creating the latest value for customers and winning the respect and trust of enterprises at home and abroad. In 2015, the design, development and production of smart watches began, mainly serving overseas major customers ODM, OEM, etc., and engaged in the production of smart wearable accessories for more than 10 years. en.sz-ddm.com
